limitations: Single small benchmark; no external validation or verified patient-level split.
Synthetic pixel perturbations are not validated acquisition physics; labels may cease to be meaningful under severe corruption.
Softmax confidence and entropy do not quantify clinical uncertainty.
Temperature and checkpoint are selected on the same 78-image validation split; calibration may overfit.
Fixed 80% / 15 pp review thresholds are demonstration policy, not clinically optimized.
Repeated conditions share the same 156 images; do not pool as independent patients.
Wilson intervals describe binomial image-level sampling only; they do not account for patient clustering or model-training variability.
One training seed; no claim of novelty over existing corruption benchmarks or clinical readiness.

threshold_study.budget_scope: Mean review workload across clean plus twelve equally weighted stress conditions
threshold_study.objective: Maximize validation errors captured subject to the 50% review budget; then minimize review count; then choose smaller cutoffs.
caveats: The study was added after the original test report was seen; this is exploratory, not a prospective or independently preregistered result.
Threshold selection code accepts validation data only. Test curves are descriptive; do not reselect cutoffs using them.
The workload budget applies to the condition-averaged validation cohort; individual conditions and final-test workloads can exceed it.
Image-condition pairs are repeated measurements, not independent patients; no pooled binomial intervals are reported.
Checkpoint selection, calibration and review tuning reuse the same 78 validation images and can overfit.
